_comment: Copy to email-accounts.json (gitignored) and add one entry per mailbox you SEND from. Connecting each account matters because the sweep needs to see your SENT mail to know whether you already replied. Receiving alias mail in the connected inbox is NOT enough. See EMAIL_SETUP.md.

gmailOAuth._note: Shared across all Gmail mailboxes below. From a Google Cloud OAuth 'Desktop app' client. Leave blank if you only use the connected default.

accounts.name: techtower
accounts._note: Connected via the Gmail connector. Receives myswimscore / techtowerops alias mail, but does NOT contain replies you SEND from those addresses.

accounts.name: myswimscore
accounts._note: Separate mailbox — connect so the sweep can see your SENT replies and won't keep flagging already-answered threads.
